name: msr-physical-ai-layer
description: Physical-AI robot fleet coordination for Molten Salt Reactor operations

msr-physical-ai.description: Local MCP server — manages 12 MSR robots over stdio (development stub when MSR_ROBOT_CONTROL_URL is unset)

notes: Set MSR_ROBOT_CONTROL_URL to connect to a live robot-control REST API.
Without the env var the server uses a development stub with representative MSR data.
See CLAUDE.md for agent rules and safety constraints.
